_doc: Endpoints + workspace layout baked into each fork's defaults + the hub's deep-link fallbacks. Data-driven: change a value here, re-materialize the affected fork, get rebuilt defaults. NO secrets — credentials flow through each fork's own login (Acode SFTP login, gitea auth), never this file. SFTP targets are WireGuard-only: the public surface is 443+51820+25, so port 22 is only reachable with the WG tunnel up on the phone — every sftp preset carries wg_only:true and the UI must surface it. WG IPs are from the cloud mesh (10.0.0.0/24).

workspace._doc: The hub-owned shared workspace tree. The hub creates/announces it; Amaze FM/Utils bookmark it; Acode opens folders under it via SAF grants handed over in the hub deep-link. `volume` is the logical name used by storage_summary + analyzeStorage().

editor._doc: Acode fork defaults. code-server is browser-only (deep-link tile, NOT an in-app client). gitea provides git remotes over public HTTPS :443. sftp_presets reference the shared `sftp` list below.

files._doc: Amaze File Manager fork default bookmarks: the workspace root plus the shared SFTP presets.

utils._doc: Amaze File Utilities fork default scan target.

sftp._doc: gcp-E2-f_0 — central proxy/control (WG hub). username filled at first connect / from ssh config.

sftp._doc: oci-E2-f_1 — analytics + workflows + public Caddy edge.
